decisions.title: Typed infer outcomes and Artifact inputs

maintained.source_label: Member-local halt default and inter-member attempt_all
maintained.instruction: Apply both scopes within one stage; continue does not authorize unknown-item resend
maintained.acceptance: Independent members still run after one fails; distinguish unattempted member rows from unattempted successor stages.

maintained.source_label: Authenticated partial-application risk acceptance
maintained.instruction: Use the same proposition type for human and policy issuers
maintained.acceptance: Reject signature, issuer, scope or claim mismatch; policy allow adds no human Checkpoint.

maintained.source_label: Row conversion failure
maintained.instruction: Fail the operation and offer a registered try_* repair as a semantic change
maintained.acceptance: to_number failure publishes no output; offer try_number without automatic application; do not evaluate unselected branches.

maintained.source_label: Guard or ceiling exceeded
maintained.instruction: Fail the protected operation; present top_k as a distinct selection choice
maintained.acceptance: Do not return a successful prefix or insert top_k with unresolved order.

maintained.source_label: External acquisition fails
maintained.instruction: Preserve failure; infer outcomes use their separate explicit failure contract
maintained.acceptance: Distinguish timeout from verified zero-row success and failure outcomes from successful values.

maintained.source_label: take requires proven stable order
maintained.instruction: Journal completion from an eligible sole candidate key
maintained.acceptance: Input enumeration changes preserve the specified prefix; reject without a key or order.

maintained.source_label: Search no-hit does not prove external absence
maintained.instruction: Use complete scoped fetch before create
maintained.acceptance: Do not admit absence-dependent Effects on partial no-hit evidence; separately check complete acquisition and write conflict guards.

maintained.source_label: Data-dependent SourceView reads use keyed joins or search_candidates
maintained.instruction: Keep infer and numeric observations as separate admitted boundaries, not arbitrary fetch DAGs
maintained.acceptance: Reject row-selected Connector/Resource/view/operation; receipt imports perform no provider reads.

maintained.source_label: Unresolved Effects and no exceptional source-state claim
maintained.instruction: Separate stage capture from Program commit eligibility
maintained.acceptance: A captured, B partially applied and C unattempted leaves cursor unchanged; recovery does not resend successes or derive checkpoints from filtered rows.

maintained.source_label: Fixed UTC functions and explicit calendar profile
maintained.instruction: Do not propagate calendar timezone implicitly into ordinary expressions
maintained.acceptance: Distinguish fixed durations from calendar days across DST; reject unprofiled timezone arguments.

maintained.source_label: NFC UTF-16 code-unit canonical order
maintained.instruction: Keep locale display order separate from semantic Results
maintained.acceptance: Independent BMP/supplementary expectations agree across targets; display sorting cannot retain the original Result CID.

maintained.source_label: Case-sensitive names and exact lowercase function/operation spellings
maintained.instruction: Keep value case_fold separate from name resolution
maintained.acceptance: Reject misspellings without fuzzy execution; distinguish admitted SQL keyword casing.

maintained.source_label: No implicit decimal/binary64 mixing
maintained.instruction: Use only closed explicit casts without inventing monetary rounding
maintained.acceptance: Distinguish decimal string 0.1 from binary64 0.1; numeric observations do not permit floating decimal aggregation.

maintained.source_label: Closed keys and exact spellings
maintained.instruction: Use registered vocabulary in diagnostic repairs
maintained.acceptance: Do not ignore unknown operations/fields or confuse prototype names and literal keys with syntax.

maintained.source_label: Program id belongs to Definition identity and stage id to its namespace
maintained.instruction: Keep display names in meta
maintained.acceptance: ID changes alter definition/intent; display-name changes preserve computation CID but update reviewed snapshots.

maintained.source_label: One delivery request selects one Result and format
maintained.instruction: Batch transport may group distinct requests and receipts
maintained.acceptance: Do not merge Results into one unnamed receipt or change Program roots through delivery selection.

maintained.source_label: Checkpoint expires under Host deadline
maintained.instruction: Cancel without rolling back Effects or erasing unknown outcomes
maintained.acceptance: Do not resume an expired Checkpoint; reconciliation may update evidence but cannot revive it.

maintained.source_label: One invalid item in stage preflight
maintained.instruction: Require zero mutations in that stage; changed scope needs a new Preview and authorization
maintained.acceptance: continue does not hide invalid rows; UI exclusion proposals are not partial release of the original Preview.

maintained.source_label: Run success is distinct from provider and business completion
maintained.instruction: Expose completed/accepted waiting through SDK and UI
maintained.acceptance: No completion notification for a subsequently failed accepted job; explicit acceptance notification remains possible.

maintained.source_label: Optional collection is a narrow homogeneous read-only union
maintained.instruction: Compose heterogeneous inputs and all-failure reports in the SDK
maintained.acceptance: Do not put Effects inside collection; distinguish all infer failure outcomes from all source Runs failing.

maintained.source_label: Results are materialized Relations
maintained.instruction: Provide SDK single-row/value access and Host progress
maintained.acceptance: singleRow errors unless exactly one row; do not truncate; progress is not a semantic Result.

maintained.source_label: Local execution requires durability
maintained.instruction: Bundle durable storage, private-evidence encryption, scope and secure key defaults without an ephemeral bypass
maintained.acceptance: No manual secret pasting for ordinary setup; recover after process restart; never expose secrets in source, diagnostics or Results.

maintained.source_label: Mapping target primary key is single-field
maintained.instruction: Distinguish Command item composites, receipt correlation and Relation keys
maintained.acceptance: Reject undeclared composite Mapping target keys without banning valid composite Relation keys.

maintained.source_label: Finite execution ceilings
maintained.instruction: Resolve limits from Host, contracts and proofs; unknown statistics alone do not reject enforceably bounded work
maintained.acceptance: Bounded work with unknown estimates runs; reject unbounded work; do not require redundant author limits.

maintained.source_label: Approval and permissions are outside source
maintained.instruction: Do not route by meta; after declares success dependency, not approval policy
maintained.acceptance: Reject author keys that strengthen or weaken review; Host routes by operation semantics.

maintained.source_label: Changed meta is within the node's signed review scope
maintained.instruction: Create a new projection and attestation while preserving the reviewed snapshot
maintained.acceptance: Computation CID stays fixed while review CID changes; do not reuse a signature for a new explanation.

maintained.source_label: No UDF or lambda escape
maintained.instruction: Use registered profiles or explicit external Host tasks
maintained.acceptance: A CID does not make arbitrary code pure ActQL; do not disguise opaque tasks as checked stage operations.

maintained.source_label: Watch and resident loops are external
maintained.instruction: Use finite changes and external scheduling; bounded polling/retry is not source recursion
maintained.acceptance: Reject dynamic stage growth, self-calls and one-stage-per-row generation.

maintained.source_label: Opaque reference equality includes its scope
maintained.instruction: Use explicit fields for business keys or content comparison while retaining full reference evidence
maintained.acceptance: Same bytes in a different scope do not permit identity-equal ArtifactRef substitution; explicit content comparison remains possible.

maintained.source_label: Public explain redacts private data
maintained.instruction: Authorize private inspection independently from review authority
maintained.acceptance: Without read authority, expose no bound values or rows; approval alone grants no payload access; never return keys.

maintained.source_label: Canonical strings and fixed CSV semantics
maintained.instruction: Keep raw bytes as Artifacts and human-oriented transformations explicit
maintained.acceptance: Do not silently rewrite CSV for spreadsheets; formula escaping produces a distinct explicit artifact and receipt.

maintained.source_label: Distribution and full conformance are separate gates
maintained.instruction: Disclose partial support and known gaps for alpha/beta distribution
maintained.acceptance: No fabricated success for unsupported operations; full claims require all normative and independent evidence.
